    "Potential premature closure if blur fires unexpectedly (e.g., when a popup steals focus), but the datepicker already handles external clicks via document mousedown listeners.",

    "Clicking outside the picker should continue to close it as before.",
    "Typing an invalid date and pressing Tab should revert the input to the previous valid date and close the picker."
  ]
}
